rows: Malian woman with deep brown skin and indigo headwrap; Egyptian woman with brown skin and linen drapery; Ethiopian woman with dark brown skin and woven shawl; Tang Chinese woman with high hair arrangement and flowing robe
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redesign the supplied Courts of Moonlight character badge sheet (image 1), using the genuinely painted blue porcelain teacup (image 2) as the MATERIAL AND BRUSHWORK STYLE reference. A production sprite sheet of 20 separate watercolour character medallions in an EXACT 5-column by 4-row equal-cell grid. NO titles, lettering, labels, borders around sheet, or grid lines. Transparent background between medallions. All five columns equal width and all four rows equal height, each complete medallion centered in its cell with generous 12% empty margins INCLUDING dangling jewels. Rows top to bottom: Malian woman with deep brown skin and indigo headwrap; Egyptian woman with brown skin and linen drapery; Ethiopian woman with dark brown skin and woven shawl; Tang Chinese woman with high hair arrangement and flowing robe. Each row same woman across five tiers. Columns left to right Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald. Bronze simple thin muted bronze oval and two leaves; Silver brushed silver oval with small moonflowers; Gold restrained antique-gold oval and a few violet flowers; Platinum intricate icy silver crescent frame with delicate blue crystals; Emerald rich blue-green jade foliage and restrained elegant crystal drops. Frames never cross faces or cover figures. Bust portraits no hands. Faces softly suggested by two or three ink wash strokes, no detailed eyes or lips, no anime, no cartoon, no glossy rendering. Strong translucent uneven pigment, soft lost edges, drybrush and paper-grain texture like old Chinese watercolour painting and the reference teacup. Retain distinct clothing cues and varied natural skin tones, NOT blue skin. Predominantly indigo, blue, lavender, porcelain white, with limited tier metal accents. No yellow or red filter, no warm glow. Distinct tiers increasing in ornament. Wide canvas 5:4 so square cells, entire sheet all 20 badges fully visible.
